question: Find the area of ​​an equilateral triangle of side 12 cm.
solution:
**Given:**

Side of the equilateral triangle = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of an equilateral triangle = (√3 / 4) × side²

**Calculations:**

Area = (√3 / 4) × 12²

Area = (√3 / 4) × 144

Area = 36√3 cm²

**The area of the equilateral triangle is approximately 36√3 cm2.**
